sloka: साधयार्थमभिप्रेतमरिष्टं प्लवतां वर ।यस्य त्वेतानि चत्वारि वानरेन्द्र यथा तव ॥५-१-१९८॥
transliteration: sādhayārthamabhipretamariṣṭaṁ plavatāṁ vara ।yasya tvetāni catvāri vānarendra yathā tava ॥5-1-198॥

translations.english: "O lord of vanaras he in whom these four qualities, fortitude, vision, intelligence and dexterity exist as in you will achieve his mission and not get lost".
